objective: Measure Physical Halation's diffusion spill and threshold response near a transparent source edge, distinguishing RGB additions from the unchanged source-alpha plane under straight and premultiplied storage assumptions.

scope.effect: PhysicalHalation CPU source equation: highlight extraction, red/green/blue box diffusion and additive composite. The wrapper copies source alpha back to output.
scope.method: Offline Float32 NumPy model of the inspected source with edge-replicated horizontal/vertical box diffusion and a local synthetic alpha-edge light stripe. This is an equation model, not a compiled or app capture.
excluded: physical scattering validation or aesthetic acceptance

comparison.baseline: The same encoded numeric fixture with Physical Halation disabled; arithmetic source-over reference only, not a visual target.
candidates: default controls threshold=.8, softness=.5, spread=15, intensity=.5, redDiffusion=2
intensity stress value 1.5 with all other controls fixed
highlight stripe normalized x=.82 interior and x=.89 alpha transition
comparison.ground_truth: None. Synthetic source-off pairing isolates the model response; no approved halation scan or alpha-edge target is available.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive response only. Report red/green/blue residuals, support beyond alpha, and association-dependent compositing. Do not judge model output as accepted halation or a product defect.

materials.fixture: Generated local smooth elliptical alpha matte over zero-RGB exterior with an opaque neutral base and a 3-pixel highlight stripe near/intersecting the right alpha transition. Source stripe RGB has white and warm-highlight segments to straddle the default luminance threshold.
materials.rights: Generated locally by the study script.
materials.identity: Record source, plan, runner, straight/premult fixture, output arrays, metrics and preview SHA-256.

regions.diffusion_spill: alpha==0 and any output RGB differs from source

conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 BGRA as accepted by the source implementation, direct numeric channel values with no transfer conversion. No output clamp; source-over backgrounds are numeric black, gray .18 and white.
conditions.source_channel_map: Halation source reads x/y/z as B/G/R respectively for Rec.601 luma and writes its red diffusion to z; script represents the same channel ordering explicitly.
conditions.alpha: Generate one logical straight foreground and zero RGB outside alpha, then premultiply RGB by alpha for the paired premultiplied input. Composite with matching equations: straight storedRGB*alpha+background*(1-alpha); premultiplied storedRGB+background*(1-alpha). Model preserves source alpha exactly.
conditions.equation: lum=B*.114+G*.587+R*.299; softness soft-knee contribution as source; highlight extraction uses contribution=max(max(lum-threshold,0),softContribution), then bounded weight. Wide red diffusion radius=int(spread*redDiffusion); narrow GB diffusion radius=int(spread). Add diffusion*intensity to source RGB, retain alpha.
conditions.regions_and_rois: Record complete alpha-region masks and a 64x64 pixel crop centered at each stripe x position / normalized y=.5; fixed ROIs are clipped to image bounds.
metrics: per-channel source-to-output RGB min/max and below-zero/above-one rates
per-region and per-background RGB composite MAE/RMSE/p95/max vs disabled baseline
transparent RGB leak/support area and max/mean per channel
diffusion extent in pixels vs normalized image size
conditions.display: Direct-clipped RGB8 contact sheets plus fixed 64x64 crops enlarged 4x nearest-neighbor; raw Float32 metrics remain authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Check source markers, no-effect identity at intensity=0, exact alpha preservation, finite outputs and edge-replicated box diffusion bounds.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Model follows declared equations within float32 tolerance; alpha remains identical. No C++ parity or appearance gate.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect full contact sheets and fixed light-source/edge crops at 1:1 and 4x enlargement; measure source-off residual and spill support separately.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail; describe per-channel halo support and local edge response.

color_and_alpha.method: Compare correctly represented straight and premultiplied fixtures over three backgrounds, retaining raw RGB separately from composite output.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual layer descriptor along each product path and downstream handling of Unknown alpha.

temporal_stability.reason: One static source and fixed settings; random-free diffusion equation has no frame sequence in this study.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Run two dimensions while holding spread in source pixels fixed; report both pixel and normalized spill extent.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Compiled CPU result, actual app route, GPU path, preview/final and Viewer transform.

performance.reason: No product timing, allocation or memory profiling.

execution.backend: Python 3 and NumPy/Pillow; local synthetic fixture only.
execution.threshold_policy: Descriptive only; no unsupported perceptual threshold is invented.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed fixture geometry, source stripes, parameter grid and edge replication; record package versions and all input/output hashes.
